title: Sue and the Clock with No Pockets
synopsis: Sue wonders where Market Street’s shop clock stores its minutes, then draws a clock with pockets for her cardboard castle bakery.
continuity_state: Before: Sue and Grandpa Ed live by the mill at Round Window Cottage, Sue owns a cardboard castle bakery with flap door, paper beetle and WINDOW ORDERS sign. Wendy and Aunt Kay know the market route. After: Sue visits Market Street’s working two-hand shop clock with Grandpa Ed, Wendy and Aunt Kay. Back at Round Window Cottage, Grandpa Ed helps attach a new paper clock face with drawn hands and a large paper pocket to the existing cardboard bakery; a folded paper sandwich stays in the pocket. The clock is pretend and does not run; the real market clock continues working. Wendy’s blue hat ribbon remains intact.
